name: project-restoration
description: 1. `npm install` 2. Copy `.env.example` to `.env` and fill your private key and Pinata keys. 3. Compile: `npx hardhat compile` 4. Test: `npx hardhat test` 5. Deploy to Mumbai testnet: `npx hardhat run scripts/deploy.js --network mumbai` 6. Open `frontend/index.html` in a browser (or serve with `npx http-server frontend`).
